## Basic tracking methods

### Identify

Link users to a recognizable `userId` and `traits`.

```js
analytics.identify([userId], [traits], [options], [callback]);
```

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `userId` | String | No | Database ID for the user. Omit to record anonymous traits only. |
| `traits` | Object | No | User attributes (e.g., email, name). Cached in `localStorage` and attached to subsequent Identify calls. |
| `options` | Object | No | Configuration dict, e.g., `{ integrations: {...} }`. Pass empty `{}` if omitting `traits`. |
| `callback` | Function | No | Executes after 300 ms timeout. |

**Notes:**
- Do NOT call Identify for anonymous visitors; Analytics.js auto-generates `anonymousId`.
- To set `userId` silently: `analytics.user().id('123')` (npm: `analytics.instance.user().id()`)
- Traits persist in `localStorage` across sessions.

Examples:

```js
// Traits only (anonymous)
analytics.identify({
  nickname: 'Amazing Grace',
  industry: 'Computer Science'
});

// With userId
analytics.identify('12091906-01011992', {
  name: 'Grace Hopper',
  email: 'grace@example.com'
});

// Callback without options/traits
analytics.identify('user_123', function(){
  // Fires after request sent
});
```

### Track

Record user actions.

```js
analytics.track(event, [properties], [options], [callback]);
```

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `event` | String | **Yes** | Event name string. |
| `properties` | Object | No | Event attributes dict (e.g., `{ price: 99, productType: 'widget' }`). Pass empty `{}` if omitting. |
| `options` | Object | No | Configuration dict, e.g., `{ integrations: {...} }`. |
| `callback` | Function | No | Executes after 300 ms timeout. |

Example:

```js
analytics.track('Article Completed', {
  title: 'How to Create a Tracking Plan',
  course: 'Intro to Analytics',
});
```

#### trackLink

Binds a Track call to a link, delaying navigation by 300 ms to ensure the event fires.

```js
analytics.trackLink(element, event, [properties]);
```

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `element(s)` | Element \| Array | **Yes** | DOM element or array of elements. **Must be an element, not a CSS selector.** |
| `event` | String \| Function | **Yes** | Event name string or function returning event name. |
| `properties` | Object \| Function | No | Properties dict or function returning properties dict. |

Example:

```js
var link = document.getElementById('free-trial-link');
analytics.trackLink(link, 'Clicked Free-Trial Link', { plan: 'Enterprise' });
```

#### trackForm

Binds a Track call to form submission, delaying submission by 300 ms.

```js
analytics.trackForm(form, event, [properties]);
```

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `form(s)` | Element \| Array | **Yes** | Form element or array of elements. **Must be an element, not a CSS selector.** |
| `event` | String \| Function | **Yes** | Event name string or function returning event name. |
| `properties` | Object \| Function | No | Properties dict or function returning properties dict. |

Example:

```js
var form = document.getElementById('signup-form');
analytics.trackForm(form, 'Signed Up', { plan: 'Premium', revenue: 99.00 });
```

### Page

Record page views; must be called at least once per page load to instantiate device-mode destinations.

```js
analytics.page([category], [name], [properties], [options], [callback]);
```

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `category` | String | No | Page category (e.g., ecommerce section). Must include `name` to send `category`. |
| `name` | String | No | Page name. |
| `properties` | Object | No | Page attributes. Analytics.js auto-collects `url`, `title`, `referrer`, `path` (uses canonical URL if available). Override explicitly if needed. |
| `options` | Object | No | Configuration dict. Pass empty `{}` if omitting `properties`. |
| `callback` | Function | No | Executes after 300 ms timeout (may not fire if device-mode library blocked). |

**Auto-collected properties:**

```js
// Calling:
analytics.page('Pricing');

// Results in:
{
  title: 'Segment Pricing',
  url: 'https://segment.com/pricing',
  path: '/pricing',
  referrer: 'https://segment.com/warehouses'
}
```

Override by passing explicit values:

```js
analytics.page('Pricing', {
  title: 'My Custom Title',
  path: '/pricing/view'
  // url and referrer auto-collected
});
```

### Group

Associate identified user with a group (company, team, organization, etc.).

```js
analytics.group(groupId, [traits], [options], [callback]);
```

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `groupId` | String | **Yes** | Group ID to associate with current user. |
| `traits` | Object | No | Group attributes (e.g., `address`, `website`, `employees`). Cached in `localStorage`. |
| `options` | Object | No | Configuration dict. Pass empty `{}` if omitting `traits`. |
| `callback` | Function | No | Executes after 300 ms timeout. |

Example:

```js
analytics.group('UNIVAC Working Group', {
  principles: ['Eckert', 'Mauchly'],
  site: 'Eckert–Mauchly Computer Corporation',
  statedGoals: 'Develop the first commercial computer',
  industry: 'Technology'
});
```

### Alias

Combine two unassociated user identities. Required by some destinations (Kissmetrics, Mixpanel).

```js
analytics.alias(userId, [previousId], [options], [callback]);
```

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `userId` | String | **Yes** | New user ID to associate. |
| `previousId` | String | No | Previous ID user was recognized by. Defaults to currently identified user ID. |
| `options` | Object | No | Configuration dict. |
| `callback` | Function | No | Executes after 300 ms timeout. |

## Utility methods

### Load

Load a buffered instance before initiating network activity. Useful for awaiting user consent.

```js
const analytics = new AnalyticsBrowser()

analytics.identify('hello world')

if (userConsentsToBeingTracked) {
  analytics.load({ writeKey: '<YOUR_WRITE_KEY>' }) // destinations load, queued events flush
}
```

Also supports async write key fetch:

```js
const analytics = new AnalyticsBrowser()
fetchWriteKey().then(writeKey => analytics.load({ writeKey }))
analytics.identify('hello world')
```

**Load options:**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `integrations` | Object | all enabled | `{ All: false, 'Google Analytics': true }` — load only specified destinations. Must include `'Segment.io': true` if setting `All: false`. |
| `obfuscate` | Boolean | `false` | Obscure CDN URLs to bypass ad blockers. |
| `disableAutoISOConversion` | Boolean | `false` | Disable auto-conversion of ISO8061 strings to Date objects. |
| `highEntropyValuesClientHints` | Array | — | Request specific client hint values: `['architecture', 'bitness', 'model', 'platformVersion', 'uaFullVersion', 'fullVersionList', 'wow64']` |
| `disable` | Boolean \| Function | `false` | Disable all tracking. Can be a function: `(cdnSettings) => boolean` |

Examples:

```js
// Load only specific destinations
analytics.load('writekey', { integrations: { All: false, 'Segment.io': true, 'Google Analytics': true } })

// Conditional load based on consent
onConsentDialogClosed((consentedTools) => {
  analytics.load('writekey', { integrations: consentedTools })
})

// Obfuscate to bypass ad blockers
analytics.load('writekey', { obfuscate: true })

// Disable for testing
analytics.load('writekey', { disable: true })
```

### Ready

Execute callback after Analytics.js initializes and all device-mode destinations load.

```js
analytics.ready(callback);
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `callback` | Function | Executes when initialization complete. |

**Notes:**
- Does NOT fire if any destination throws an error (expired API key, incorrect settings, browser blocked).
- Check `window.analytics.initialized` (boolean, not an event) to detect successful init.
- Use to access destination native libraries:

```js
analytics.ready(() => {
  window.mixpanel.set_config({ verbose: true });
});
```

### Debug

Enable/disable console debug logging.

```js
analytics.debug(true);  // Enable
analytics.debug(false); // Disable
```

### On (Emitter)

Listen for Alias, Group, Identify, Track, or Page events and run custom code.

```js
analytics.on(method, callback);
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `method` | String | Method name: `'track'`, `'identify'`, `'page'`, `'group'`, `'alias'` |
| `callback` | Function | Executes with `(event, properties, options)` |

Example:

```js
analytics.on('track', (event, properties, options) => {
  bigdataTool.push(['recordEvent', event]);
});
```

**Note:** Emits *before* Segment processing; may not include all normalizations. Page event properties stored in Options object.

### Timeout

Set callback/helper function timeout (ms).

```js
analytics.timeout(500);
```

Useful for `trackLink` and `trackForm` with slow load times (e.g., ad network conversion pixels).

### Reset

Clear stored `userId`, `anonymousId`, and traits/group properties.

```js
analytics.reset();
```

**Note:** Only clears Segment cookies/localStorage. Doesn't clear third-party tool cookies.

## Managing data flow with integrations object

Control which destinations receive an event via `options.integrations`.

```js
analytics.identify('user_123', {
  email: 'jane.kim@example.com',
  name: 'Jane Kim'
}, {
  integrations: {
    'All': false,
    'Intercom': true,
    'Google Analytics': true
  }
});
```

- `'All': false` + explicit `true` entries = allowlist
- Omit `'All': false` + explicit `false` entries = blocklist (default)

Destination flags are **case-sensitive** and match catalog names exactly (e.g., "AdLearn Open Platform", "awe.sm", "Mailchimp").

Example blocklist:

```js
analytics.identify('user_123', {
  email: 'jane.kim@example.com',
  name: 'Jane Kim'
}, {
  integrations: {
    'Intercom': false,
    'Google Analytics': false
  }
});
```

## Delivery strategy configuration

### Custom headers

Add custom headers to delivery requests:

```ts
analytics.load("<YOUR_WRITE_KEY>", {
  integrations: {
    'Segment.io': {
      deliveryStrategy: {
        config: {
          headers: { 'x-api-key': 'foo' }
        }
      }
    }
  }
});
```

### Keepalive

Enable fetch `keepalive` to capture events during hard redirects (page unload).

```ts
analytics.load("<YOUR_WRITE_KEY>", {
  integrations: {
    'Segment.io': {
      deliveryStrategy: {
        config: {
          keepalive: true
        }
      }
    }
  }
});
```

**Default behavior:** keepalive used automatically on page unload if batching enabled.

**⚠️ Warning:** Keepalive payloads limited to 64 KB total across all in-flight requests. Large batches may lose data on browser close. Reduce batch size/timeout if needed.

## Batching

Group multiple Track/Page/Identify/Group/Alias events into single batch request. All events in batch share same `receivedAt` timestamp.

```js
analytics.load("<write_key>", {
    integrations: {
      "Segment.io": {
        deliveryStrategy: {
          strategy: "batching",
          config: {
            size: 10,
            timeout: 5000
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });
```

| Option | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `size` | Number | Events-per-batch threshold. After N events, batch sends immediately. |
| `timeout` | Number | Milliseconds to wait before forcing batch send, regardless of size. |

**Constraints:**
- Total batch payload max: 500 KB
- Max per-event: 32 KB
- Batch auto-splits if exceeds 500 KB

**Important:**
- Batching applies ONLY to `Segment.io` destination, not device-mode integrations.
- Doesn't impact billing or throughput.
- Doesn't work on Internet Explorer or with Partner Integrations.

## Source middleware

Run before plugins to enrich, validate, or drop events.

```js
analytics.addSourceMiddleware(({ payload, next }) => {
  const { event } = payload.obj.context;
  
  // Enrich
  if (event.type === 'track') {
    event.event = event.event.toLowerCase();
  }
  
  // Validate & drop
  if (!isValid(event)) {
    return null; // Drop event
  }
  
  next(payload);
});
```

## Advanced plugins

Register plugins to modify event lifecycle. Plugins define `name`, `type`, `version`, `load()`, and `isLoaded()`.

**Plugin types:**

| Type | When | Notes |
|------|------|-------|
| `before` | Before other plugins run | Thrown errors block pipeline. Source middleware treated as `before`. |
| `enrichment` | First processing level | Modifies events. Thrown errors block pipeline. |
| `destination` | As events pass to destinations | Segment.io is a destination plugin. Thrown errors do NOT block pipeline. |
| `after` | After all processing | Cleanup operations. |
| `utility` | Once during bootstrap | Gives access to analytics instance via `load()`. Can't modify events. |

### Example enrichment plugin

```js
export const lowercase = {
  name: 'Lowercase events',
  type: 'enrichment',
  version: '1.0.0',
  isLoaded: () => true,
  load: () => Promise.resolve(),
  track: (ctx) => {
    ctx.updateEvent('event', ctx.event.event.toLowerCase());
    return ctx;
  }
};
```

### Example with external data enrichment

```js
const identityStitching = {
  name: 'Identity Stitching',
  type: 'enrichment',
  version: '0.1.0',
  load: async (_ctx, ajs) => {
    user = ajs.user();
  },
  isLoaded: () => user !== undefined,
  async identify(ctx) {
    const req = await fetch(`https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users/${ctx.event.userId}`);
    const userReq = await req.json();
    ctx.updateEvent('traits.custom', userReq);
    user.traits(userReq);
    return ctx;
  }
};
```

### Register plugins

```js
await window.analytics.register(pluginA, pluginB, pluginN);
```

## Retries

Analytics.js auto-retries on network/server errors (up to 10 retries, exponential backoff). Events stored in `localStorage` (fallback: in-memory) if retries enabled.

**Limits:** Max 100 queued events to avoid excessive `localStorage` use.

**Metadata note:** `_metadata` recalculated on each retry; may not reflect original delivery status if destination settings changed between retries.

## Cookies and localStorage

**Cookies set (1-year expiry in Chrome):**

| Cookie | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `ajs_anonymous_id` | Auto-generated anonymous ID |
| `ajs_group_id` | Group ID from Group call |
| `ajs_user_id` | User ID from Identify call |

**localStorage keys (no expiry):**

| Key | Purpose |
|-----|---------|
| `ajs_user_traits` | Traits from Identify call |
| `ajs_group_properties` | Properties from Group call |
| `ack`, `reclaimStart`, `reclaimEnd`, `inProgress`, `queue` | Retry queue management (if retries enabled) |

Set `debug` cookie to `'analytics.js'` to enable console debug logging.

**Note:** Analytics.js only sets first-party cookies, not third-party.

## Cross-subdomain tracking

Analytics.js tracks across subdomains by default. `anonymousId` set at top-level domain, persists across all subdomains. Include snippet on each subdomain.

**Note:** Cross-top-level-domain tracking not supported out-of-box. Use Querystring API to pass `anonymousId` via query string.

## UTM tracking

Analytics.js auto-parses UTM parameters from URL query string and adds to `context.campaign`:

| Parameter | Maps to |
|-----------|---------|
| `utm_source` | `campaign.source` |
| `utm_medium` | `campaign.medium` |
| `utm_campaign` | `campaign.name` |
| `utm_content` | `campaign.content` |
| `utm_term` | `campaign.term` |

**Non-persistent:** UTM params removed from `context` when URL no longer contains them.

**Example:** URL `?utm_source=mysource&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mytestcampaign` produces:

```js
"context": {
  "campaign": {
    "medium": "email",
    "name": "mytestcampaign",
    "source": "mysource"
  }
}
```

**Filter custom params:** Use source middleware to allowlist only standard params:

```js
window.analytics.addSourceMiddleware(({ payload, next }) => {
  if (payload.obj.context?.campaign) {
    const allowedFields = ["source", "medium", "term", "campaign", "content"];
    const campaign = payload.obj.context.campaign;
    Object.keys(campaign).forEach(key => {
      if (!allowedFields.includes(key)) {
        delete campaign[key];
      }
    });
  }
  next(payload);
});
```

## Performance notes

- Analytics.js + snippet: ~1.1 KB page size increase
- Customized `analytics.min.js` bundle: ~62 KB baseline + per-destination overhead
- Library loaded asynchronously; adjust code if event ordering matters
- No native JS lib needed for Zendesk, Salesforce, Mailchimp (server-side delivery)
- Only enabled destinations' libraries loaded
- First-party cookies only; no third-party cookies

## Tracking blockers and browser privacy

Segment does not endorse bypassing tracking blockers. Recommended approaches:

1. Respect user's choice to block (accept some data loss)
2. Request customer disable blockers for corporate accounts
3. Move tracking to server-side library (avoids client-side blocking)

**Workarounds (not guaranteed effective):**
- Bundle obfuscation: obscure CDN URL to bypass ad-blocker keywords
- Custom proxy: change cdn.segment.com and api.segment.io URLs
- Server-side libraries: eliminate client-side blocking concerns (requires manual context passing for url, path, referrer, etc.)

## Custom global namespace

Change global variable from `window.analytics` to avoid naming conflicts (requires snippet v5.2.1+):

```diff
- !function(){var i="analytics", ...
+ !function(){var i="custom_key", ...
```

Then access as `window.custom_key`.

## Bundling destinations from npm

### Actions-based destinations

```js
import vwo from '@segment/analytics-browser-actions-vwo'
import braze from '@segment/analytics-browser-actions-braze'

const analytics = AnalyticsBrowser.load({
  writeKey: '<WRITE_KEY>',
  plugins: [vwo, braze],
})
```

List of action destinations: [@segmentio/action-destinations](https://github.com/segmentio/action-destinations/blob/main/packages/destinations-manifest/package.json)

### Classic destinations

```js
import { AnalyticsBrowser } from '@adpharm/silo-analytics'
import GoogleAnalyticsIntegration from '@segment/analytics.js-integration-google-analytics'

const analytics = AnalyticsBrowser.load({
  writeKey: '<WRITE_KEY>',
  classicIntegrations: [ GoogleAnalyticsIntegration ]
})
```

## Segment Inspector (Chrome extension)

Debug Chrome extension for Analytics.js. Install from [Chrome web store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/segment-inspector/jfcbmnpfbhhlhfclmiijpldieboendfo).

**3 tabs:**

1. **Diagnostics:** Library versions, active integrations, integration options
2. **Events:** Per-event details (time, status, payload at each stage)
   - Single-check icon: payload at trigger
   - *fx* icon: payload after plugins
   - Double-check icon: payload at delivery
3. **Identity:** User traits (client-side only)
